if: the supply is a supply of services under forward charge
the invoice IS issued within the period prescribed under s.31
then: this limb yields the EARLIER of the date of issue of invoice and the date of receipt of payment
note: This limb is conditional on the invoice being timely. If it is not timely, s.13(2)(b) applies instead and the tax point moves to the date of provision of service. The prescribed period lives in s.31, which is not extracted here.
